claims: The inaugural Java House Grand Prix of Arlington took place from March 13-15, 2026.
The Java House Grand Prix of Arlington featured an IndyCar street race around AT&T Stadium and Globe Life Field.
Kyle Kirkwood of AJ Foyt Racing won the race on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
Kyle Kirkwood took the INDYCAR series lead.
The track is located in the Arlington Entertainment District surrounding AT&T Stadium and Globe Life Field.
The Java House Grand Prix of Arlington was the first-ever IndyCar race in Arlington.
Kyle Kirkwood outdueled Alex Palou in the final laps to win.
Max Taylor won the INDY NXT event.
Sunday concerts were canceled due to high winds.
The track is designed to showcase the Arlington Entertainment District.
The track has spectator areas near major venues, including Choctaw Stadium.
The 2026 weekend included practice, qualifying, and the main race.
The event was broadcast on FOX.
The Java House Grand Prix of Arlington brought IndyCar, Indy NXT, and supporting racing to the North Texas area.
